correctness.rationale: For two scalar sensors precision r>s used exactly once at consecutive observation times, derived posterior information J_rs=s+1/[q+a²p/(1+rp)] and J_sr=r+1/[q+a²p/(1+sp)]. Independently confirmed exact factorization J_rs−J_sr=(r−s)[t/((t+νC)(t+νD))−1], t=a²>=0, ν=q/p>0, C=1+pr, D=1+ps. Thus stronger-first iff fν(t)=t²+[ν(C+D)−1]t+ν²CD<0. AM–GM yields ν*=1/(sqrt C+sqrt D)². For ν below, precisely one open two-root stronger-first window; at critical one tie, above stronger-last everywhere. Discriminant factorization gives square-root closing width and small-noise Vieta expansions; t>=1 strictly stronger-last. Exact finite examples support but do not replace this universal argument.
